body: Works good! I just wonder, it doesn't work with `local_to_scene` on. I guess it's for the case of pasting between scenes (it already gets duplicated with `local_to_scene`). But I think when pasting in the same scene, it should be allowed. I was wondering why it didn't work at first until I saw the code and realized the resource was set to `local_to_scene` on.

Alright, it works even with `local_to_scene` on now! This feature is good to use when pasting between scenes since apparently they're still linked until the scene is saved and reloaded... And obviously within the same scene!

I'm still wondering about the option name like I mentioned in the proposal since it's not immediately apparent that it's talking about resources being unique, but it's fine for now, I guess, since I can't think of any clean and short option name that mentions it.
